The title of this work hardly perhaps defines the 
author’s object with sufficient accuracy. A complete 
history of what the Dey and his Divan fondly called 
‘ The famous and warlike city of Algiers ’ would 
comprise that of all the maritime states of Europe

His son Anthony emigrated to New Amsterdam, arriving with his wife Grietje Reyniers, in 1630.
